description: Replace Jellyfin for the single-user LAN playback stack. Slim Mediarr server (disable -arr domains, single trusted-LAN user), drop the deprecated Kotlin Android TV client, make the Flutter Netflix-styled client the only TV client. Hermes owns the -arr work; the Flutter client keeps speaking the existing Jellyfin-compatible surface so no client rewrite is needed.
deviation_notes: Spec format is classic FR list: this is a consolidation/pivot against an existing in-progress track, and the acceptance criteria are wire-level (config flag, route surface, APK install). Owner decision recorded 2026-09-20: extend the existing TS surface behind a config seam rather than extract a slim service or rewrite in Go (jellyfin-go). Reuses the in-progress feature_jellyfin_server_surface_20260729 surface; narrows its scope from 'stock Jellyfin TV app parity' to 'what the Flutter client exercises'.
